Topics covered in this PDF

BHIE-144 (Traditions of History Writing in India) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Buddhist constructions of the past in the Pali chronicles, Bakhars, Ashokan edicts, Domingo Paes on Vijayanagara, Baruni
  • Genealogies, Firishta, Mangosteens' Indica, nationalist writings, environmental history

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: three assignments, answer all questions, marks 100, assignment code BHIE-144/ASST/TMA/2026-27. Assignment I: two questions of 20 marks (about 500 words each). Assignment II: three questions of 10 marks (about 250 words each). Assignment III: five questions of 6 marks (about 100 words each)

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.
